We need to fix compilation errors. Issues: imports for JUnit5 (org.junit.jupiter) but project seems using JUnit4. Also using MockitoJUnitRunner which is JUnit4. We have both @ExtendWith (JUnit5) and @RunWith (JUnit4) causing missing classes. Simplify: Use only JUnit4 imports: import org.junit.Before; import org.junit.BeforeClass? Already have @Before. The test uses @BeforeEach which is JUnit5. Replace with @Before (JUnit4). Remove @ExtendWith and its import. Also remove import for MockitoExtension. Also need to import org.junit.runner.RunWith and org.mockito.runners.MockitoJUnitRunner (or org.mockito.junit.MockitoJUnitRunner?). The code uses @RunWith(MockitoJUnitRunner.class). That class is org.mockito.junit.MockitoJUnitRunner (in newer Mockito). Need import org.mockito.junit.MockitoJUnitRunner; not org.mockito.runners. Add import.

Also need to import org.junit.Test, org.junit.Before. Already have.

Remove duplicate setup method: there is @BeforeEach method and also @Before method. Keep one. Use JUnit4 @Before for setup. Remove @BeforeEach method and its annotation. So we will have a single @Before method.

Also need to import org.junit.Assert.* already static import.

Let's rewrite class:

- Remove @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) annotation.
- Keep @RunWith(MockitoJUnitRunner.class) and import org.mockito.junit.MockitoJUnitRunner;
- Replace @BeforeEach with @Before.
- Remove import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension; and import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
- Ensure we have import org.junit.Before; (already there) and import org.junit.Before; (duplicate but okay).
- Also need import org.junit.runner.RunWith; already there.

Now code compiles.

Also note that Position class may have getGrossProfit() method defined; tests rely on it.

Let's produce corrected code.
